The Istrian County is bilingual under its statute (Croatian and Italian), and the Constitutional Law on National Minorities guarantees bilingualism where a minority makes up a third of the population (Vukovar). A change of borders is a decision of the Sabor by a 2/3 majority; entering a union with other states is possible only through a referendum (Art. 142 of the Constitution), and the exit from Yugoslavia in 1991 was also approved by referendum.
